spec.title: Setup initial repo and site
spec.content:
# Setup initial repo and site

Create a Vite React app that can be used as a Hello World Example for the RVASDUG Meetup.

Run the following:

```
npm create vite@latest rvasdug-meetup-hello-world -- --template react
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev
```
